name: benchmark_usb_cable
description: Benchmarks physical USB cable throughput, PHY link speed negotiation, and power delivery via ADB without wearing flash storage.

test_size_mb.description: Payload size in Megabytes streamed into RAM per iteration (default: 1024)

iterations.description: Number of test iterations to execute (default: 3)

include_power.description: Whether to query voltage, amperage, and charging metrics (default: true)

device_serial.description: Specific Android device serial number if multiple devices are connected
